definition_zh: 烈火；火焰；光辉； blazing 般的爆发；v. 燃烧；发光；开拓
definition_en: a strong bright fire, or to burn brightly and fiercely
core_image: 正午烈日下腾起的一团火光
scene: 干柴堆被点燃，火光冲天而起。The fire blazed through the dry forest all night.
sceneCN: 这里 blaze 是「熊熊燃烧」（第 2 个义项：猛烈而明亮地燃烧）；句意是大火在干燥的森林里烧了整夜。

derivatives.zh: blaze 加 -ing，义为「燃烧的；炽烈的」
blaze 加 -er，义为「运动夹克」（源自「鲜艳夺目」义）
a- 加 blaze，义为「着火的；闪耀的」

senses.title: A bright, strong fire
senses.example: Firefighters fought the blaze for hours.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员与大火搏斗了几个小时。
senses.why: The Germanic root means to blow or shine; strong fire is the concrete core.
senses.whyCN: 日耳曼词根本指吹气或发亮，烈火是其具体核心。

senses.title: To burn brightly
senses.definition: to burn fiercely and with bright light
senses.example: The fire blazed through the dry forest all night.
senses.exampleCN: 大火在干燥的森林里烧了整夜。
senses.why: The noun made into a verb keeps the sense of fierce, visible burning.
senses.whyCN: 名词转动词，保留猛烈而可见的燃烧之义。

senses.title: A burst of bright light or colour
senses.definition: a brilliant display of light or colour
senses.example: The garden was a blaze of colour in May.
senses.why: Bright fire and bright colour are read by the same eye.
senses.whyCN: 明亮的火与明亮的色，在眼中是同一种「亮」。

senses.title: To shine intensely
senses.definition: to give out strong light, as eyes or the sun
senses.definitionCN: 发出强光，如眼睛或太阳
senses.why: Eyes that flash feel as hot as fire to the observer.
senses.whyCN: 闪光的眼睛在观者眼中如火焰般灼热。

senses.title: A sudden outburst of emotion
senses.definition: a sudden powerful showing of feeling or violence
senses.definitionCN: 情感或暴力的骤然强烈表露
senses.example: The speech set off a blaze of outrage.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇讲话激起了轩然大波的愤怒。
senses.why: Emotion burns like fire; the metaphor is the oldest fire we know.
senses.whyCN: 情感如火燃烧，这是人类最古老的火之隐喻。

senses.title: A mark cut on a tree to mark a path
senses.definition: a mark made on a tree to show a trail
senses.definitionCN: 刻在树上用于标示路径的痕迹
senses.example: Hikers followed the white blazes along the trail.
senses.exampleCN: 远足者沿着路上的白色路标前行。
senses.why: A blaze of the axe strips bark in a flash of pale wood.
senses.whyCN: 斧头一击剥落树皮，露出一片亮白的木色，故称 blaze。

senses.title: To pioneer a new path
senses.definition: to be the first to explore or develop something new
senses.definitionCN: 率先探索或开辟新领域
senses.example: She blazed a trail for women in engineering.
senses.exampleCN: 她为女性进入工程界开辟了道路。
senses.why: Pioneers cut trail marks; to blaze a trail is to chop the first path.
senses.whyCN: 先驱者砍刻路标，blaze a trail 即砍出第一道路径。

senses.title: To shoot continuously
senses.definition: to fire guns rapidly and continuously
senses.example: The soldiers blazed away at the targets.
senses.exampleCN: 士兵们朝目标连续射击。
senses.why: Muzzle flashes are little blazes, and firing repeats them.
senses.whyCN: 枪口火光如小火焰，连发便是火焰连绵。

intro.en: Blaze is a native Germanic word for bright fire.
intro.cn: blaze 是日耳曼本土词，本指明亮的火。

items.en: a reconstructed root blas-, connected with shining or blowing; exact form uncertain.
items.cn: 重构词根 blas-，与「发亮、吹气」相关，具体形式不确定。

items.en: blaese meant a torch or bright fire.
items.cn: 古英语 blaese 意为「火把；明亮的火」。

items.en: the tree-mark sense arose separately, probably from a blaze of pale wood.
items.cn: 中古英语时期生出「树皮刻痕」义，或因斧痕露出白亮木色。

items.en: blaze a trail was fixed in American frontier speech.
items.cn: 17 世纪 blaze a trail 在美国边陲用语中定型。

items.en: senses of fire, light, outburst, and pioneering all remain in use.
items.cn: 火、光、爆发、开拓诸义沿用至今。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers sound-alike words; the near-meaning group gathers words of fire and light.
note.cn: 形近组收音近词；近义组收火焰与光亮类词。

entries.definitionCN: 釉面——拼写相近，词源不同
麻木的——法语借词，拼写相近
大火灾——正式用语，偏灾害

normalIntro.en: Blaze is the old Germanic word for bright fire, and it lights many phrases.
normalIntro.cn: blaze 是「明火」的古老日耳曼词，许多短语由它点亮。

normal.en: Blaze a trail means to pioneer.
normal.cn: blaze a trail 意为开辟道路。

normal.en: A blaze of colour is brilliant colour.
normal.cn: a blaze of colour 指绚丽的色彩。

normal.en: Blaze away can mean to keep firing or working.
normal.cn: blaze away 可指连续开火或埋头猛干。

normal.en: Blazer the jacket comes from the blazing colour of team strips.
normal.cn: 运动夹克 blazer 得名于队服的鲜艳色彩。

abstract.en: See dry pines burst into flame at a single spark.
abstract.cn: 看干燥的松林被一颗火星点燃。

abstract.en: Feel the noon sun blazing on the back of your neck.
abstract.cn: 感受正午烈日在颈后灼烧。

abstract.en: Picture an axe biting pale wood on a trail tree.
abstract.cn: 想象斧刃在路标树上咬出一片白色木痕。

examples.en: The fire blazed through the dry forest all night.
examples.cn: 大火在干燥的森林里烧了整夜。

examples.en: She blazed a trail for women in engineering.
examples.cn: 她为女性进入工程界开辟了道路。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不累死」——大火烧一整夜都不累死，火势何等旺盛。

root: 日耳曼本土词：古英语 blaese「火把；明亮的火」，出自重构的日耳曼词根 blas-（与「发亮、吹气」相关，形式不确定）；「树皮刻痕」义或另起于斧痕露出的白亮木色，后衍生 blaze a trail「开辟道路」。

sensesIntro.en: From torch fire to trail marks to fiery emotions, blaze keeps the image of bright, burning force.
sensesIntro.cn: 从火把到路标到炽热的情感，blaze 始终保有明亮燃烧之力量的意象。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: dry pines erupting into flame at a spark
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗火星点燃干燥的松林

intro.en: Blaze is a native root with a compact family.
intro.cn: blaze 是本土词根，词族紧凑。

latinIntro.cn: 日耳曼词根，无拉丁同族词。

items.structure: Old English blaese, noun and verb
